headline: Mercy and Queens arrive level at conference play
dek: Each has won five, drawn one and lost once, and each has conceded six goals. Mercy's opening-day defeat at home to East Stroudsburg is still their only one, and Jacob Darwesh Lund-Iversen has scored eight of their fourteen goals from seventeen shots.
displaced_by: Queens beat Wilmington and Mercy beat American International on Sep 16, leaving both on five wins, one draw, one defeat and six conceded; the standing dek's four wins and eleven goals were no longer true

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Queens have scored nineteen goals, more than any other programme, and nine different players have scored them; the attack is spread across the side rather than carried by one striker.

wire.line: Molloy have conceded three goals all season and lost once, at home to Assumption; Daemen are their first conference visitors.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches are past their date with no result published: District of Columbia's opening-day trip to Shepherd and Molloy's at Caldwell.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Daemen have conceded 22 goals, more than any other programme, and are still without a win; the home defeat to Slippery Rock was their fifth.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Queens have won every match since the defeat at Holy Family, the latest at home to Wilmington, and have conceded six goals all season against nineteen scored.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lorenzo Herrera has made 35 saves and conceded five for District of Columbia, who have lost once, at Slippery Rock.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Staten Island's eleven goals have come from eight different players, and the win at home to Goldey-Beacom was their second of the season.

last_match.line: Mercy have not lost since opening day, and American International had already been held scoreless by St. Thomas Aquinas.

next_match.line: Queens have scored in every match this season; Roberts Wesleyan have conceded in every one of theirs.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
